title: GNN-Spatial-Strain-SHM: Graph Neural Networks for strain-based SHM of composite panels
description:
Code and data accompanying the article Graph neural networks for SHM: exploiting spatial interdependencies of strain data for diagnostics and prognostics, Structural Health Monitoring, 2025, doi:10.1177/14759217251386802.

Implements the GENEA (GENConv with Edge Attributes) model, the load-decoupled Health Indicator derived from the cumulative absolute first derivative of strain, and the Leave-One-Panel-Out cross-validation protocol used in the paper. The paper_code/ directory holds the scripts that produced the published results, together with reference metrics and per-fold checkpoints; the repository root holds the earlier model-selection code behind the GNN architecture comparison.

The measurements under Data/ derive from the H2020 MORPHO project dataset (doi:10.5281/zenodo.14627730, CC BY 4.0). Code is MIT licensed; data is CC BY 4.0.
